title: ynf factory
description: A factory's configuration repository: .agents/factory/factory.yaml, read from its default branch at a resolved commit (ADR-006). Which repositories ynf works on, and the trackers and forges it works with. Default lanes for every enrolled repository go beside it in lanes.yaml.

repos.description: The enrolled repositories: host/owner/name, or owner/name on the default forge. ynf reads a target repository's lanes only when it is enrolled here.

trackers.description: Tracker instances by name (ADR-003), declared only here: they carry credentials and name servers ynf starts.

forges.description: Forge instances by name (ADR-003), declared only here.
